image_description: A group of people, including children and adults in colorful costumes (red skirts, black tops), are dancing around a tall wooden pole (maypole) in a grassy outdoor area with bare trees in the background. They are holding long, multi-colored ribbons attached to the top of the pole.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central wooden pole is clearly visible, extends vertically beyond the top of the frame, and is significantly taller than the surrounding dancers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Colorful streamers extending from top to ground, each long enough to be held by a standing dancer.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple ribbons in red, blue, yellow, and white extend from the upper section of the pole down to the hands of the dancers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct red, blue, yellow, and white/light pink streamers are visible attached near the top of the visible pole section.

The pole is the focal point of the activity, with all participants oriented towards it.
